package.description: A completely free backup software for the Mozilla Thunderbird E-mail client.

en-US.description: A completely free backup software for the Mozilla Thunderbird E-mail client.
en-US.longDescription: Backup Thunderbird is a free Thunderbird backup utility for Windows. It enables you to quickly backup and restore all of your Mozilla Thunderbird E-Mail Messages, Newsgroups, RSS Feeds, Address Books, E-Mail Accounts and all other options.
